dataset.name: Signal Test Commons 512-channel challenge
dataset.description: Saved challenge report contains 80 frames across four generated episodes on a 16 by 32 grid.

protocol.name: Signal Test Commons challenge
protocol.locked_at: not stated in the saved report
protocol.description: Saved report evaluates an absolute threshold of 4.5; event recall is the fraction of fault episodes with an alarm in the labeled interval; localization is micro Jaccard over injected frame-group sets.

metrics.name: group localization accuracy
metrics.note: Computed in the source report over injected frames only: 1,041 localized frame-group pairs / 1,123 union pairs.

interpretation: The saved deterministic synthetic challenge reports all three generated fault episodes detected, zero false alarms on 67 clean frames, and group localization micro-Jaccard 0.9269813. These values describe only the bundled synthetic challenge and threshold.
limitations: The challenge and all scores are synthetic. Its source explicitly says these results do not establish performance on physical instruments.
One seed (7), one threshold, and one 80-frame saved challenge are represented; the example includes no comparative baseline report.
Localization accuracy is calculated only on injected frames, as defined by the source; it is not a measure of physical spatial accuracy.
